description: Source code for legacy autograd profiler in PyTorch, including thread-local state management, event recording, and callback setup for profiling.

classes.name: ProfilerLegacyThreadLocalState
classes.description: Manages thread-local profiling state, including event lists and remote events, for legacy profiling.

methods.name: consolidate
methods.description: Consolidates event lists and remote events into a single list.

methods.name: mark
methods.description: Adds a mark event with a given name, optionally including CUDA.

methods.name: setOrAddRemoteProfiledEvents
methods.description: Stores remote profiled events for later consolidation.

methods.name: pushRange
methods.description: Starts a profiling range for a given function, recording input shapes if configured.

methods.name: popRange
methods.description: Ends a profiling range for a given function.

methods.name: reportMemoryUsage
methods.description: Records a memory allocation event if memory profiling is enabled.

methods.name: getEventList
methods.description: Retrieves or creates an event list for a specific thread.
